answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: a newcomer joins only when five neighbors on its knoll stake 60 each, listed in the orchard. It must do fresh work first. Each epoch a raven brings a surprise re-check to a sponsor; a fake fails, all bonds burn. Forging 1,000 identities needs 5,000 sponsors and 300,000 locked credits against a 40,000 pool, so it loses money. Rented neighbors lose their bond if a fake is caught; honest agents pay 60 once and keep full share.
